_doc: Registry of every instrumentation hook SimSpect has ever built into a gem5 build, plus the observation-layer parsers and the config->env bridge. REALIZATION hooks are gem5 *source* changes that manufacture the speculative scenario (the only gem5-source edits we allow — per CLAUDE.md, never touch the defense logic). OBSERVATION hooks are checker-side parsers of gem5's existing debug trace (no source change). Source: wiki/design/METHODS_INSTRUMENTATION.md (the 9 source sites + the parser table) + gem5-hooks/README.md. Viewed in the dashboard Utilities > gem5 hooks (purposes) tab.

categories.realization: gem5 SOURCE hook — manufactures the speculative window / forces the scenario. The porting checklist for a new build.
categories.observation: checker-side parser of gem5's existing debug output — no source change (always allowed).
categories.bridge: the config -> env -> checker plumbing that makes a run reproducible by hand.
categories.observation-source: gem5 SOURCE hook that only PRINTS (no defense/timing change): adds trace events gem5 did not print. Allowed under CLAUDE.md (hooks only, never defense logic).

hooks.name: Branch BTB override (forced target)
hooks.purpose: Force a branch to predict TAKEN/NOT-TAKEN to the modeled direction via --branch-ann-file, realizing the mispredict the Alloy model specified. Vanilla builds reject the flag.
hooks.builds: recon-modded, stt, stt-dbg, gem5-spt, all 4 amulet

hooks.name: Per-branch resolve stall
hooks.purpose: Hold a branch unresolved for N cycles after the force, keeping the speculative window open so everything after it stays speculative.

hooks.name: First-not-committed commit stall
hooks.site: o3/{O3CPU,BaseO3CPU}.py (fncCommitStallPC/Cycles params); o3/cpu.{hh,cc}; o3/commit{.hh,_impl.hh/.cc} (fncStallSeqNum/Cycles + stall loop before squash check)
hooks.purpose: Stall commit of the first-not-committed insn at the ROB head (recon/STT use 150 cyc), widening the speculative window so slow VP/squash cases land in-window. The amulet builds originally LACKED this; ported (7 sites) to InvisiSpec/SpecLFB/CleanupSpec.
hooks.builds: recon-modded, stt, stt-dbg, gem5-spt, amulet InvisiSpec/SpecLFB/CleanupSpec (NOT confirmed on amulet-STT)

hooks.name: CLI flags
hooks.purpose: Expose the hooks: --branch-ann-file, --branch-ann-base, --fnc-commit-stall-pc, --fnc-commit-stall-cycles. SpecLFB (newer base) needed a hex-parse fix on --branch-ann-base.

hooks.name: se.py annotation loader + wiring
hooks.purpose: Read each test's .ann.json, resolve each branch PC (absolute branch_addr, else function-relative offset + base — conflating these was a real bug fixed across all amulet builds), push annotationBranchPCs/ForcedTargets/ResolveStallCycles into the BP, and set fncCommitStall PC/Cycles (guarded >0).
hooks.builds: all instrumented (each amulet build needed the +base fix individually)

hooks.name: STL store address-generation hold
hooks.site: o3/BaseO3CPU.py (stlStallStorePCs, stlStoreStallCycles); o3/iew.{hh,cc} (executeInsts store path: rescheduleMemInst + release event)
hooks.purpose: Hold an annotated store's address generation for N cycles (--stl-ann-file + --stl-store-stall-cycles) so a younger aliasing load issues first and bypasses it (its SQ entry has size 0). When it executes, checkViolations squashes from the load: the window end.
hooks.builds: none built yet (written 2026-10-28; gem5-hooks/stl/apply_stl_hooks.py, reference diff vs gem5 v22.0.0.2)

hooks.name: STL memory-dependence prediction override
hooks.site: o3/BaseO3CPU.py (stlAliasLoadPCs, stlAliasStorePCs, stlAliasPred); o3/mem_dep_unit.{hh,cc} (insert: no-alias zeroes the store-set dep; alias primes the store set before insertStore)
hooks.purpose: --stl-alias-pred: no_alias = false-negative prediction for the annotated bypass loads (the primitive); alias = false-positive control (the load waits, no window should open); off = unmodified store sets. Replaces the unwired gem5-recon-modded store_set_annot, which primed at the load's checkInst (too late for the first dynamic instance).
hooks.builds: none built yet (same patch as stl_store_addr_hold)

hooks.name: STL trace events
hooks.purpose: Print-only O3PipeView:simspect:<tick>:STL:{stl_hold,stl_release,pred_no_alias,pred_alias,mem_order_squash} lines (SIMSPECT_HOOKS.md format) so the STL window is read from the pipeview trace alone.

hooks.name: pcstate instrumentation (recon-modded)
hooks.purpose: The recon-modded-specific BTB-override / Recon instrumentation beyond the standard 9 sites (captured in recon-modded_src.diff).

hooks.name: parse_pipeview
hooks.purpose: Read O3PipeView issue/complete/squash ticks per seqNum -> the complete-tick half of the data-obtained leak gate.

hooks.name: parse_lsq
hooks.purpose: Read LSQ 'Executing load', packet_tick, spec_read_tick, (SpecLFB) memaccess_tick, (InvisiSpec) expose_tick -> the load checker's signal + cache-fate. SpecLFB's newer base needed an additive memaccess_tick (no 'sent out packet' line).

hooks.name: parse_commit_squashes
hooks.purpose: Read pc -> squash ticks (the B2 fix): check_br keys on the squash tick, not the resolve tick. Needs the Commit debug flag.

hooks.name: collect_unresolved_branches / check_branch_resolutions
hooks.purpose: Compare the annotation's branch list vs the trace -> the 'branches still unresolved' window gate.

hooks.name: SimSpect cache/defense event trace (O3PipeView:simspect lines)
hooks.site: Ruby: SLICC peek+doTransition codegen, CacheMemory, TBETable, x86 TLB, ROB::squash (+ InvisiSpec Sequencer/AbstractController/LSQ, CleanupSpec LSQ); classic (SpecLFB): BaseCache allocateBlock/handleEvictions/invalidateBlock/refillBlocks, BaseSetAssoc::accessBlock, ROB::squash. Per-build detail in 'sites'.

sites.amulet-InvisiSpec: src/sim/simspect_hooks.{hh,cc}; src/mem/ruby/slicc_interface/SimSpectRubyHooks.{hh,cc}; mem/slicc/ast/PeekStatementAST.py (noteMsg per peek); mem/slicc/symbols/StateMachine.py (begin/endTransition around doTransition); mem/ruby/structures/CacheMemory.cc (allocate/deallocate/setMRU); mem/ruby/structures/TBETable.hh (MSHR/L2MSHR/DIRTBE alloc/free + attribution); arch/x86/tlb.cc (DTLB/ITLB); cpu/o3/rob_impl.hh (squash); mem/ruby/system/Sequencer.cc (SB buf_fill/buf_release, expose/validate); mem/ruby/slicc_interface/AbstractController.cc (LLCSB); cpu/o3/lsq_unit_impl.hh (SB release on squash)
sites.amulet-CleanupSpec: same shared Ruby sites as InvisiSpec (no Sequencer/AbstractController edits) + cpu/o3/lsq_unit_impl.hh (cleanup_skip for split/L1-hit/no-info loads, cleanup_done in clearLoadQueue)
sites.amulet-SpecLFB: src/sim/simspect_hooks.{hh,cc}; mem/cache/base.cc (allocateBlock fill, handleEvictions evict, invalidateBlock inv, refillBlocks LFB buf_fill/buf_release); mem/cache/tags/base_set_assoc.hh (repl_touch); cpu/o3/rob.cc (squash); mem/cache/mshr_queue.cc (MSHR buf_fill/buf_release)

hooks.event_mapping: Ruby: CacheMemory::allocate -> fill (cleanup_restore under a *ROLLBACK* SLICC event); deallocate -> evict (event contains 'Replacement') | cleanup_inv (Inv_CLEANUP, Cleanup_Invalidate[_clean]) | inv (else); setMRU -> repl_touch; doTransition stable->stable present state change with no tag change -> coh. CleanupSpec decision events (Skip_ROLLBACK, Load_ROLLBACK on present line, Inv_CLEANUP on NP/I/M, Inflight_CLEANUP_reqs, Drop_Load_Cleanup_Inflight, L2 SendAck_Cleanup_Invalidate in NP, LSQ split/L1-hit skips, clearLoadQueue) -> cleanup_skip/cleanup_drop/cleanup_done; full table in the doc. Classic: allocateBlock -> fill, handleEvictions victims -> evict, invalidateBlock (not in a replacement) -> inv, accessBlock LRU touch -> repl_touch, refillBlocks push/refill -> LFB buf_fill/buf_release. TBE alloc/free (Ruby) and MSHRQueue allocate/deallocate (classic) -> MSHR/L1IMSHR/L2MSHR/DIRTBE buf_fill/buf_release. Every structure present is exported; criterion JSONs filter. Prefetch fills (no prefetcher configured) would print as fill with seq=-.
hooks.attribution: seq from the request (the Ruby builds' O3 creates every data Request with the inst seqNum; SpecLFB sets setReqInstSeqNum). Exact for Ruby L1 events processed from a Sequencer RubyRequest and for classic events with a CPU packet; L2/DIR/LLCSB/response-driven events use a per-line most-recent-cause map. seq=- for instruction fetch (no inst exists yet) and lines no instruction requested.
hooks.purpose: Give the footprint-defense criteria (TRANSMISSION_CRITERIA_FORMAT.md) a per-line, per-instruction event trace in the pipeline output itself, replacing ad-hoc ProtocolTrace/Cache parsing.
hooks.verified: 2026-10-28: identical non-simspect O3PipeView lines, parse_pipeview output and sim ticks vs the pre-hook binary on InvisiSpec inst-002014, CleanupSpec uv4split, SpecLFB uv6x/inst-002014/inst-014986. LFB events compiled but not exercised (no isUnsafe=1 load in the gadgets tried).

hooks.name: config -> env bridge
hooks.site: pipeline.py:_build_gem5_env -> SIMSPECT_* env read by gem5_common.py
hooks.purpose: Translate run_config gem5.* keys into SIMSPECT_GEM5_BIN/SE_CONFIG/GEM5_CPU/GEM5_EXTRA/FNC_COMMIT_STALL_CYCLES/BRANCH_ANN_ENABLE so any checker run that exports the same env reproduces the campaign's exact build/scheme/hook state.

hooks.name: sweep stall injection
hooks.purpose: sweep.* stalls (unresolved_stall_cycles etc.) are injected into the annotation, NOT env vars; forwarded as SIMSPECT_SWEEP_CFG (the B3 diagnostic bug was forgetting this).

known_gaps: commitToIEWDelay — needed to exercise the VP<->squash race gadget; flagged in claudelog as NOT in the stock pipeline / not wired into _build_gem5_env.
CleanupSpec post-squash residue correlator — install<->cleanup event watcher not yet fully built.
fnc_commit_stall on amulet-STT — not confirmed ported; verify before relying on window timing there.
simspect_cache_events: no coh on classic caches (SpecLFB); LFB buf_fill/buf_release not yet exercised at runtime; L1I/ITLB events have seq=- (fetch precedes the instruction).
